name: Exchange Online PowerShell
postCreateCommand: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "Set-PSRepository -Name PSGallery -InstallationPolicy Trusted; Install-Module -Name ExchangeOnlineManagement -Scope CurrentUser -Force -AllowClobber -Repository PSGallery; New-Item -ItemType File -Path $PROFILE.CurrentUserAllHosts -Force | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path $PROFILE.CurrentUserAllHosts -Value 'Import-Module ExchangeOnlineManagement'"
